profile.name: AbdElKader Seif El Islem Rahmani
profile.kicker: PhD candidate · Lead AI Engineer · University lecturer
profile.headline: Researching how agents improve themselves. Building the systems that run them.
profile.intro: PhD research on generative-AI methods for autonomous agents and self-improvement behavior, alongside production AI engineering (LLM workflows, RAG, agent systems, backend infrastructure) and university teaching.
profile.researchFocus: Generative-AI methods for autonomous agents and self-improvement behavior, PhD in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence), University Centre of Naama.
profile.researchAreas: Autonomous and self-improving agents, LLM systems, adaptive multi-agent systems, reliable AI architectures.
aboutParagraphs: I research how LLM-based agents can retain, reflect and adapt, and I build AI systems for real clients. Each side corrects the other: production shows where agent ideas break, and research gives structure to what I build.

Currently: PhD work on generative-AI methods for autonomous agents, AI platform engineering as a technical owner, and teaching computer science and AI courses at the universities of Naama and Saida. Languages: Arabic (native), English (fluent), French (conversational).
